[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

b### Images

Content references an image by **key** (`"image": "roSystem"`), and
[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.

usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

p### Images

Content references an image by **key** (`"image": "roSystem"`), and
[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

 ### Images

Content references an image by **key** (`"image": "roSystem"`), and
[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

i### Images

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

e### Images

Content references an image by **key** (`"image": "roSystem"`), and
[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

r### Images

Content references an image by **key** (`"image": "roSystem"`), and
[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

n### Images

Content references an image by **key** (`"image": "roSystem"`), and
[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

m### Images

Content references an image by **key** (`"image": "roSystem"`), and
[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

l### Images

Content references an image by **key** (`"image": "roSystem"`), and
[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

 ### Images

Content references an image by **key** (`"image": "roSystem"`), and
[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

a### Images

Content references an image by **key** (`"image": "roSystem"`), and
[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

d### Images

Content references an image by **key** (`"image": "roSystem"`), and
[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

i### Images

Content references an image by **key** (`"image": "roSystem"`), and
[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

)### Images

Content references an image by **key** (`"image": "roSystem"`), and
[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

l### Images

Content references an image by **key** (`"image": "roSystem"`), and
[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

a### Images

Content references an image by **key** (`"image": "roSystem"`), and
[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

l### Images

Content references an image by **key** (`"image": "roSystem"`), and
[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

n### Images

Content references an image by **key** (`"image": "roSystem"`), and
[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

7### Images

Content references an image by **key** (`"image": "roSystem"`), and
[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.

usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

k### Images

Content references an image by **key** (`"image": "roSystem"`), and
[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

r### Images

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

R### Images

Content references an image by **key** (`"image": "roSystem"`), and
[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

t### Images

Content references an image by **key** (`"image": "roSystem"`), and
[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

t### Images

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.

usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

o### Images

Content references an image by **key** (`"image": "roSystem"`), and
[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

a### Images

Content references an image by **key** (`"image": "roSystem"`), and
[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

t### Images

Content references an image by **key** (`"image": "roSystem"`), and
[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).

o### Images

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

[lib/images.ts](lib/images.ts) is the only place that knows what a key points at.
Resolution happens once in the content seam, so components always receive a
usable path — a raw key can never reach `next/image`. An unknown key fails the
build with a named error, exactly like an unknown icon.

Files live in `public/images/` and are **local on purpose**: a corporate firewall
or an offline laptop must not be able to break the site's images, and a
placeholder CDN is not a dependency worth having.

The shipped files are on-brand gradient placeholders. To use real photography,
drop your files into `public/images/` with the same names (updating the extension
in `lib/images.ts` if needed). To serve from a CDN instead, point a value at a
full `https://` URL and add that hostname to `images.remotePatterns` in
[next.config.mjs](next.config.mjs).
